name: The Legend of Stalvan
label: Quest
description: A scratched entry in Darkshire points the search for Stalvan Mistmantle toward Goldshire.

clips.title: The story
paras: A scratched entry in Darkshire points the search for Stalvan Mistmantle toward Goldshire.

Clerk Daltry finds another destination beneath Stalvan Mistmantle's earlier entry in Darkshire's town registry. The hurried note is partly scratched out, as if someone meant to hide the route or changed their mind. It points northwest, toward the Lion's Pride Inn in Elwynn Forest.

You leave Duskwood's shadowed groves for Goldshire's sunny roads, but Stalvan's trail reaches here too. The Lion's Pride Inn stands at Elwynn Forest's crossroads, where travelers, merchants, and soldiers gather. Innkeeper Farley runs the busy taproom and may know of an educated wanderer looking for a room.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh my! Must have missed this the first time. In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out. Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire. Might want to check there, friend.
